fragments.name: camel-case-modules.md
fragments.text:
### Breaking

- Modules are named in camelCase or after their export: `standard-schema.ts` becomes `standardSchema.ts`, `cli/run-main.ts` becomes `cli/runMain.ts`, `engine/baseline-file.ts` becomes `engine/baselineFile.ts`, `engine/run-rules.ts` becomes `engine/runRules.ts`, `imports/pnpm-workspace.ts` becomes `imports/pnpmWorkspacePatterns.ts`, `inventory/ignore-scope.ts` becomes `inventory/ignoreScope.ts`, `rules/built-in.ts` becomes `rules/builtIn.ts`, `rules/manifests-sorted.ts` becomes `rules/manifestsSorted.ts`, `rules/max-lines.ts` becomes `rules/maxLines.ts`, `rules/comments/pattern-rule.ts` becomes `rules/comments/definePattern.ts`, the comment rules `rules/comments/max-per-file.ts`, `no-banner.ts`, `no-environment-pragma.ts`, `no-jsdoc.ts`, `no-line-reference.ts`, `no-pr-reference.ts` and `no-todo.ts` become `maxPerFile.ts`, `noBanner.ts`, `noEnvironmentPragma.ts`, `noJsdoc.ts`, `noLineReference.ts`, `noPrReference.ts` and `noTodo.ts`, and the suppression rules `rules/suppressions/biome-overrides.ts`, `no-double-cast.ts`, `no-inline.ts` and `stylesheet-comments.ts` become `biomeOverrides.ts`, `noDoubleCast.ts`, `noInline.ts` and `stylesheetComments.ts`. Rule ids are unchanged.

fragments.name: error-only-report.md
fragments.text:
### Breaking

- Remove `quality lint --warnings`; `Level` and `ActiveLevel` are `"error"` only. Remove `Outcome.warnings`, `ReportContext.warnings` and the `WarningDetail` export. The `lint` function takes only `cwd` and `config`.

fragments.name: source-first-conditions.md
fragments.text:
### Added

- `manifests/source-first` reports a `package.json` `exports` or `imports` condition block that lists the `source` condition after another condition, because TypeScript then reads built declarations instead of the sources once they exist.
